name: Zosma
description: A naked-eye star 17.9 parsecs away, 2.6 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 97603: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.328 +/- 0.009 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 2.557 +/- 0.02

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 97603: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 2.061 +/- 0.006

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 97603: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 8085 +/- 42

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3990320597065899776 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 97603: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 55.82 +/- 0.25 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 18 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 2.6 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 1.328 milliarcseconds, which gives 2.557 solar radii and 8,085 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 97603: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
